_provenance: Schema-derived fixture — F5 RED phase (2026-06-17). AC-7: malformed/partial companyfacts payloads that must NEVER cause an exception. Each entry in 'cases' has a 'label' (describes the malformation) and 'companyfacts' (the partial payload). The producer must degrade honestly — return available=False or omit the concept — but never raise.

cases.label: missing_units_key
cases._description: concept data dict has no 'units' key at all

cases.label: nonlist_unit_entries
cases._description: units value is a dict instead of a list (not the SEC spec but must not raise)

cases.label: entry_missing_end
cases._description: unit entry dict has no 'end' key — should be treated as oldest (empty string sort key), never raise

cases.label: entry_missing_filed
cases._description: unit entry dict has 'end' but no 'filed' key — secondary sort key missing, must not raise

cases.label: empty_us_gaap
cases._description: facts.us-gaap is an empty dict — no recognized concepts at all, must return available=False

cases.label: empty_units_list
cases._description: concept present but its USD units list is empty — concept must be omitted, no raise
